[INTRO
Yeah. You left without a word. Without a reason. Without a trace.
But you never really left. You just became a ghost. Haunting every room. Every memory. Every new beginning.

This is Chapter Seven. This is the ghost.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
You vanished like smoke on a windy December…
Left me with the questions that I'll always remember…
Why did you go? What did I do?
The ghost doesn't answer, the ghost just haunts you…
I see your face in the crowd when I know you're not there…
I hear your voice in the silence, a permanent prayer…
You're not dead, you're just gone, and that's worse than the grave…
The ghost is the memory that I never forgave…

[VERSE 2]
You linger in the corners of every new start…
A phantom limb aching where you used to have a heart…
I can't love again without seeing your shadow…
The ghost is the reason that the garden won't grow…
You didn't just leave, you left a stain on my soul…
A permanent reminder that I wasn't whole…
The ghost doesn't age, the ghost doesn't change…

[VERSE 3]
I've tried to exorcise you with the drink and the pills…

But the ghost doesn't leave, the ghost just waits…
For the quiet moments when the silence grates…
You're the first thought I have when the sun comes up…
The last one I swallow from a bitter cup…
You vanished from my life but you stayed in my head…
The ghost is the reason that the love is dead…

[VERSE 4]
But I'm done with the haunting, I'm done with the chase…
I'm exorcising you from every single space…
You don't get to linger, you don't get to stay…
The ghost is a debt that I'm finally gonna pay…
Not to you. To myself. To the life I rebuild…
The ghost is a void that I'm finally gonna fill…
With a new name, a new face, a new permanent flame…
The ghost is the past. And the past is in the grave…

[OUTRO
The ghost.
You vanished. But the haunting is over. I'm reclaiming every room you tried to own.
Forever.

1069cf0991fb96457dc556d6b2b5150e1ec283a4.title: Interest Compounded
1069cf0991fb96457dc556d6b2b5150e1ec283a4.lyrics:
[INTRO
Yeah. You never asked. You just took. My time. My energy. My money. My soul.
You called it friendship. I called it a slow bleed.
The leech doesn't stop feeding until the host is dead. But the host isn't dead.
The host is awake. And the feeding is over.
This is Chapter Three. This is the leech.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
You showed up at my door when your world was on fire…
I gave you my shoulder, I gave you my wire…
I fed you my resources, I fed you my time…
You took every morsel and you called it a climb…
The leech doesn't thank you, the leech just consumes…
Fills up on your spirit, then abandons the room…
When the well ran dry, you vanished like smoke…
Left me with the debt and the heart that you broke…

[VERSE 2]
You drained my savings with a sob story pitch…
Said you'd pay me back, said you'd scratch the itch…
But the itch was my wallet and the scratch was a lie…
The leech always has a reason not to try…
You borrowed my car and you returned it on E…
You borrowed my life and you returned it to me…
Empty. Hollow. A shell of what I was…
The leech is the reason that the trust has a cost…

[VERSE 3]
I saw you posting pictures from a beach vacation…
While I was working doubles to afford my medication…
The money that I lent you was the money that I needed…
But the leech doesn't care, the leech just succeeded…
In draining every drop from the vessel that they chose…
Now the vessel's empty and the leech goes…
Looking for a new host, a new vein to slice…
But the leech forgets: every debt has a price…

[VERSE 4]
So I'm sending you the bill with the interest compounded…
Every hour that you stole is a wound that's been sounded…
The leech doesn't get to walk away clean…
The leech gets exposed for the parasite they've been…
I'm not asking for a payment, I'm not asking for a fight…
I'm just making sure the leech never sees the light…
Of my door, of my life, of my permanent trust…
The leech is a lesson in the permanent disgust…

[OUTRO
The leech.
You drained me. But the well is closed. And the thirst you feel now is your own.
Forever.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

c792b4fe2ebfa3c14044b9374a6b2a000fd01dce.lyrics:

The serpent doesn't strike with fangs. It strikes with syllables.
But the truth is anti-venom. And I've been building immunity for years.
This is Chapter Four. This is the serpent.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
You told me I was crazy when I caught you in the act…
You flipped the whole script and you made me feel attacked…
For asking simple questions, for wanting to believe…
That the person that I loved wasn't practicing to deceive…
The serpent doesn't strike, the serpent just suggests…
Plants a little doubt and then the victim does the rest…
You had me apologizing for the things you did to me…
The serpent is the master of the twisted memory…

[VERSE 2]
You gaslit every argument, you rewrote every fight…
You made me question if the day was really night…
The truth was in my hands but you convinced me it was glass…
Shattered on the floor while you were covering your tracks…
The serpent is a surgeon with a scalpel made of words…
Cuts so clean the victim never knows it hurts…
Till the blood pools up and the wound starts to show…
The serpent is the reason that the trust will never grow…

[VERSE 3]
I kept the screenshots. I kept the proof…
While you were telling everyone I was the one aloof…
You played the victim perfectly, a masterful display…
While I was drowning in the narrative you gave away…
But the serpent has a weakness that the serpent can't escape…
The truth is a mirror and the mirror doesn't shape…
To the lies that you whisper, to the tales that you spin…
The mirror reflects the serpent from within…

[VERSE 4]
Now the truth is on the table and the table's set for you…
Every lie you ever spoke is a permanent tattoo…
On the skin of your reputation, on the face that you hide…
The serpent can't slither when the light's on the inside…
So choke on the venom that you meant for my soul…
The serpent is the one who's losing control…
Of the narrative, the story, the myth, and the mask…
The serpent is the answer to the question I asked…

[OUTRO
The serpent.
You twisted everything. But the truth is a straight line. And it leads directly to you.
Forever.

This is Chapter Two. This is the rat.

[VERSE 1]

The rat thinks the darkness is a safety net…
But I've been in the shadows longer than you've been alive…
The rat is the first one that the reaper will arrive…

[VERSE 2]
You whispered my secrets to the enemy's ear…

The rat is the one who poisons their own health…
I don't need revenge, I just need to watch…
The rat devour the rat in the dark of the blotch…

[VERSE 4]
So run if you want, hide if you can…
The rat always circles back to the man…

The rat is the one who's forever aloof…

The rat is the one who's alone for good…
The debt is recorded, the interest is steep…

The rat.

Forever.

0f000900e4ae187921c78293724aa3d1083a8f5e.lyrics:
[INTRO
Yeah. You took my friends. You took my family. You took my lovers. You took my heroes.
And now you're standing at my door. Scythe in hand. Eyes hollow.
But you should know something about me.
I don't kneel. I don't beg. I don't go quietly.
This is Chapter Eight. This is the reaper.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
You took my father when I was too young to understand…
You took my mother with a cold and silent hand…
You took my brother, you took my best friend…
You've been collecting from me since the beginning of the end…
The reaper doesn't negotiate, the reaper doesn't care…
The reaper just arrives with that cold and empty stare…
But I've been watching you work for forty-plus years…
And I've learned every move, and I've catalogued the tears…

[VERSE 2]
You think you're undefeated, you think you're the champ…
But every soul you've taken is a permanent stamp…
On the record of my rage, on the fire in my chest…
The reaper is the enemy I've studied the best…
I've seen you in the hospital, I've seen you in the street…
I've seen you in the faces of the people that I meet…
You're not a mystery, you're just the final debt…
And I've been paying interest since the day that we met…

[VERSE 3]
You took my youth, you took my health, you took my peace of mind…
You've been chipping at my spirit since the day I learned to grind…
But the reaper has a weakness that the reaper can't conceal…
You only take the body, not the soul that's truly real…
The ones you thought you buried are still living in my chest…
Every heartbeat is a rebellion, every breath is a protest…
Against the silence that you offer, against the void you bring…
The reaper is a season. But I'm the permanent spring…

[VERSE 4]
So come and take your swing, take your best shot at my soul…
I've been dying since the cradle, and I'm still in control…
Of the narrative, the legacy, the mark that I leave…
The reaper is a thief, but I'm the one who won't grieve…
I'll meet you at the door with a smile on my face…
You can't erase the truth, you can't erase the trace…
Of the life that I lived, of the love that I gave…
The reaper is the servant. And the servant is the slave…

[OUTRO
The reaper.
You took everyone. But you don't get to take me.
I'm walking through that door on my own terms.
The Vengeance Codex is complete.

This is Chapter Six. This is the mirror.

You stored them in a vault and you saved them for years…
To use against me when the moment was right…
The mirror was a weapon in the dark of the night…

You answered every call while you built up the wall…

2882023f4b80e13951ab26a1acd0c5d6c567fa60.title: Wrench in the Design
2882023f4b80e13951ab26a1acd0c5d6c567fa60.lyrics:
[INTRO
Yeah. The machine. The gears. The grind. The system that doesn't care if you live or die.
It took my years. It took my health. It took my sanity. And it never even blinked.
But machines have weak points. And I've been studying the blueprint.
This is Chapter Five. This is the machine.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
The alarm goes off and I'm already tired…
Another day of feeding what the factory required…
The machine doesn't sleep, the machine doesn't rest…
It just takes your best years and leaves you with the stress…
I gave it my back, I gave it my spine…
It gave me a paycheck that never aligned…
With the cost of the living, with the weight of the load…
The machine is the reason that the soul gets sold…

[VERSE 2]
The bosses sit in offices with bonuses in hand…
While the workers break their bodies on the factory land…
The shareholders profit from the blood on the floor…
They call it "efficiency," I call it a war…
Against the working class, against the human soul…
The machine is designed to keep you under control…
With the debt, with the fear, with the permanent grind…
The machine is the prison for the body and mind…

[VERSE 3]
I watched my father break his back for thirty years straight…
Then they gave him a watch and they sealed his fate…
No pension, no thank you, no permanent rest…
Just a lifetime of labor and a hole in his chest…
The machine doesn't grieve, the machine doesn't mourn…
It just finds a new body when the old one is worn…
The machine is a vampire, the machine is a thief…
